title: Visit Barcelona for a day with/without tickets
text: Daniela is a wonderful guide who adapts to any traveler and their conditions or characteristics. She got us tickets for the Sagrada Familia in a moment when we didn't have them, explains everything, and makes the visit super enjoyable by taking you to hidden corners that you would never visit otherwise. Also, the fact that the visit is by car means you can visit many important areas and the day is incredibly productive. It was a great experience to see the old area, Rambla, Montjuic, Sagrada Familia, Park Guell in just one day. Without a doubt, highly recommended and wonderful.
author: 170lourdesl

title: Great day
text: Katy gave us a wonderful tour -it was our first time in Barcelona and she showed us many attractions ~ a true professional ~ very knowledgeable.
author: Lisa_B

title: Amazing Tour and guide.  Highly recommend.
text:
We had an excellent private family tour of Barcelona with our two adult children. Our guide Pablo was very friendly and made everyone feel comfortable right away.
He was extremely knowledgeable and shared Barcelona’s history in an engaging, interesting way. The tour was well-paced, and he happily answered all our questions. We learned so much more than we would have on our own.
Highly recommend this private tour — our guide was the highlight of our trip!
author: JenniferMP

title: Excellent tour! Our guide...
text: Excellent tour! Our guide was punctual and informative. Perfect for a half-day glimpse of the city before or after a cruise.

title: Private tour of Barcelona
text: Daniela Corbella was a fabulous tour guide for our 5 hour tour of Barcelona including Park Gweill. She is very knowledgeable and accommodating for our group of three ladies.  She shared the history of each site we visited.
author: carolynwilson22

title: Fantastic family tour for teenagers.
text: Stephanie was a fantastic tour guide who had in-depth knowledge of all the sites we saw. She was also very flexible, stopping for gelato and a special Corpus Christi day at the Cathedral, which were not on the tour. My teenage boys said Barcelona was pretty cool, which is about as big of a compliment as you get.  Wish we had a couple more hours with her.
author: kristinh545

title: Barcelona tour review (gothic quarter, segrada, and park guell)
text: Stephanie was so great. She was friendly and extremely knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona. We spent a couple of hours with her and feel like we can spend days with her due to her kindness, humor, and overall love and appreciation for Barcelona. She even assisted us with booking a train to Costa Brava the next day. You won’t regret booking with Stephanie!
author: Paul K

title: Great tour guide!!!!!
text: We had a private tour with Stephanie at Park Guell and other parts of Barcelona as part of our two week vacation in Spain--it was awesome! She is so well educated, knowledgeable, and passionate about history and architecture. We highly recommend her!
